description: Inputs of test case EC-001 (electro-thermal coupling through the four Power ports). A six-node satellite of thermal design table 1 with explicit material masses, five path connections, one synchronized instant for the single-port derivative checks, illustrative Power stand-in overrides and a 400 km circular orbit for the one-orbit joint run. Every value is an illustrative test value written for this case; no device has been selected or measured.

provenance.note: Masses, specific heats, surfaces and connections are of the order of a small computing satellite; they were chosen so that the battery stays inside the Power stand-in temperature range [253.15, 333.15] K during one orbit.
provenance.power_model: sdtwin_sim.power_stand_in, a stand-in written from the Power design report (P1 to P11, valid and event_required of its 5.1 and 5.5); it is not the production Power module

thermal.rated_load_source: illustrative rated power of Compute01 for this case

instant.comment: One synchronized instant for steps 1 to 4: satellite at +X of GCRS, Sun along +X, body rotated 30 degrees about Z, so the solar array front sees the Sun at 30 degrees incidence. Earth albedo and infrared per surface are fixed illustrative inputs.

overrides.source: EC-001 case data: cell area, efficiency and normal of the SolarArray01 front, four series by two parallel cells, PDU01 efficiency

power.initial_T_B_K_comment: The battery initial temperature is thermal.initial_temperature_K.B, held by the ThermalState only (thermal design 9.4; Power design: kept by Thermal). The stand-in scene record requires initial_state.T_B_K for its own initial check; the test fills it with that same value.
power.small_charge_comment: Step 2 stand-in case: the request equals the rated load of Compute01 (thermal.rated_load_W) and the irradiance is chosen so that P_pv_max exceeds the distribution input power request / eta_D by small_charge_surplus_W; the battery absorbs that surplus with a small charging current.

orbit.attitude_comment: body +X is turned 45 degrees from the satellite-to-Sun direction within the plane normal to the projected orbit normal; body +Z is the orbit normal projected normal to the Sun direction

injection.comment: Power results injected through PowerCoupling.solve; times avoid the 60 s output grid. The shortfall window and the restart command lie in the sunlit arc before the eclipse entry near 1683 s.
